New York: the trade's own week here is about to get its biggest stage yet.

New York City Jewelry Week returns for its ninth year, Nov. 16-22, with more than 175 events citywide and online. This year's largest edition builds around a craftsmanship theme, with live demonstrations for the first time, National Jeweler reports.
